scope: Prerequisite inspection for a six-case paired autonomy and writing comparison; no behavioral qualification.

checks.finding: Native text worker disables tools, SOUL, normal context files, memory and background review. It cannot exercise actual task execution or the normal effective instruction stack.
Artifact worker has terminal/file tools but uses injected leaf-worker instructions and skips normal SOUL, memory and context loading.
Existing pilot supports runtime-smoke and injected-instruction-study purposes, not natural discovery or full-stack equivalence.
CLI has per-run route, query, workspace, iteration and time-budget controls, but no advertised per-run replacement SOUL and skill-source pair. Ignore-rules/safe-mode remove other context as well.
Inspected Desktop creation overrides pin model/provider/reasoning/service tier and profile/workspace, not an isolated SOUL/skill pair.
SOUL loads from the agent's home; tool availability also changes system guidance. Adding baseline text to a task or removing tools would not reproduce the requested controlled comparison.

decision: Use the plan's stop condition: no inspected existing lane establishes the required controlled full-stack comparison without additional setup/adapter work. Do not silently substitute a reduced-stack study.
limits: No provider call, model callability test, or quality trial was made.
This is a limitation of the inspected comparison paths, not proof that Hermes cannot support such a trial.
Existing patches remain deployed; their behavioral benefit remains unverified.
next_options: Authorize a one-use native comparison adapter/setup that stages the two instruction versions and verifies equivalent surrounding prompts/tools before inference; retain the original case and output caps.
Narrow the claim to an injected-instruction study using the existing artifact runner, explicitly excluding normal Desktop behavior and natural skill discovery.
